newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner wins British construction deal.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner wins British construction deal.

text.p: Norway's Kvaerner ASA said on Monday its construction subsidiary had been awarded a 450 million crown contract to build an underground rock characterisation laboratory in West Cumbria in Britain.

Awarded by Britain's state-owned nuclear waste disposal company Nirex UK Ltd, the contract involves the design and construction of two five-metre-diameter vertical shafts t be sunk to a depth of between 650 and 900 metres connected at the bottom by a tunnel.
The project will be carried out by Kvaerner Cementation working in joint venture with its South African-based sister company Cementation Mining.
